Hi all — I pulled the account by email (sam.ortiz@acmeanalytics.com) and can confirm a $1,000 promotional credit was issued on 2026-04-09 by automated policy. The credit ID is CREDIT-ACME-20260409-1.

What likely happened: there was an automated billing run on 2026-04-10 before the credit was attached to the billing profile (race condition). The platform records show the credit issuance timestamp 2026-04-09T23:50:12Z but the billing snapshot for April 10 had already been generated. That produced an invoice line for the token usage.

Actions I took:
- Opened a billing adjustment ticket (internal) to reissue a corrected invoice and apply the credit retroactively.
- Placed a temporary hold on collections for invoice_47823.
- Pushed a credit application request to the finance queue — target ETA 24–48 hours.

Samantha, once the adjustment is processed you should see an updated invoice and the balance drop to $0 (or show the credit-applied line). If you prefer a manual credit rather than waiting for the adjustment I'll issue a manual settlement credit now.

Attachment: internal-billing-note.txt (internal)
